# mdzgholi.ge - Driver On Call and Car Services in Georgia
URL: https://mdzgholi.ge
Description: mdzgholi.ge offers professional driving services, including 24/7 sober driver (ფხიზელი მძღოლი), personal driver, car wash with pickup, tow truck (evacuator), and airport transfers in Tbilisi and throughout Georgia.

## Contact & Booking
- Phone & WhatsApp: +995 568 83 47 07
- Operating Hours: 24/7 (24 hours a day, 7 days a week)
- City: Tbilisi and all regions of Georgia
- Driver Arrival Time: 15-20 minutes on average

## Key Service: Sober Driver (ფხიზელი მძღოლი / მძღოლი გამოძახებით)
- What it is: A professional sober driver meets you at your location (restaurant, bar, party, event, clinic, or home) and drives you home safely in your own car.
- Starting price: From 40 GEL in Tbilisi. Pricing is determined via transparent upfront verbal agreement with the dispatcher based on route and requirements.
- Common situations: After drinking alcohol at restaurants or gatherings, fatigue/exhaustion, medical procedures, or car transfers.

## Other Services
- Personal Driver (პირადი მძღოლი)
- Tow Truck / Evacuator (ევაკუატორი)
- Car Wash with Pickup (მანქანის რეცხვა გადაყვანით)
- Airport Transfer (აეროპორტის ტრანსფერი)
- Battery Jump & Tire Change (აკუმულატორი და საბურავი)

- კომპანია: mdzgholi.ge

- საწყისი ფასი: 40 ლარიდან (სიტყვიერი შეთანხმებით).
- მოსვლის დრო: 15-20 წუთი.
